markers.title: Swinging Bar & Ledges
markers.desc: Inside the ruined building. Push the large box over to the ledge next to it to reach them, and continue the climb to reach [Citizen 246's Recollection].

markers.title: Ledge, Swinging Bar & Platform Drones
markers.desc:
Grab the ledge for a few seconds to move the drones into position and reach a swinging bar.

Connects to a platform where you can find a can of [Nectar Cranberry], and stretches a little further towards a [Rope] that connects to the platform with a button you can press to get inside the tower.

markers.title: Rope
markers.desc:
On the backside of the tower. Use the [Ledge, Swinging Bar & Platform Drones] to begin climbing, then continue jumping past the can to reach it.

Connects to a platform where you can get inside the tower.

markers.title: Ledges & Swinging Bar

markers.desc: In and around the buried opera house. Used to reach the bottom safely.

markers.title: Rope
markers.desc: Can be lowered by interacting with the mechanism near the end of the overpass.

markers.title: Bus
markers.desc: At the end of the broken overpass. Get on top of the road via the lower section to the north, then shoot the explosive barrels next to the bus to use it as a platform.

markers.title: Platform Drones
markers.desc:
Outside the solar tower after they're sent here during the [Reboot!!!] side quest.

Hop onto the railings to get enough height to reach the drone and begin climbing the tower.

markers.title: Ledges
markers.desc:

markers.title: Rope

markers.title: Rope

markers.title: Rope

markers.desc:

markers.title: Small Box #1
markers.desc:
Next to a wrecked bus in the fenced-off area.

Push it and [Small Box #2] onto the pressure pads in front of the '7' pillar to get one step closer to [The Haven Milk Tea] can.

markers.title: Small Box #2
markers.desc:
Next to the stone wall in a fenced-off area.

Push it and [Small Box #1] onto the pressure pads in front of the '7' pillar to get one step closer to [The Haven Milk Tea] can.

markers.title: Small Box #6
markers.desc:
Behind a fragile wall that you can destroy by shooting the barrel behind it.

Push it and [Small Box #5] onto the pressure pads to the front-left and back-right of the '4' pillar to get one step closer to [The Haven Milk Tea] can.

markers.title: Small Box #5
markers.desc:

Push it and [Small Box #6] onto the pressure pads to the front-left and back-right of the '4' pillar to get one step closer to [The Haven Milk Tea] can.

markers.title: Small Box #3 & #4
markers.desc:

Push them onto the pressure pads on the left and right of the '6' pillar to get one step closer to [The Haven Milk Tea] can.

markers.title: Clues
markers.desc:
Scattered around the ground floor of the opera house, and can only be interacted with during the [Madama Machine] side quest. The clues consist of:
- 2x posters on the walls near the door
- 2x interview boards near the pillars
- 2x blue devices on the ground
- 1x corpse near the seats holding an entry token
